about: Aropax (paroxetine), by brand name only, is supplied eight times from September 2025 to March 2026 to a 73-year-old.

Fluoxetine (APO-Fluoxetine) 20 mg, two capsules a day (40 mg a day, above the EU(7)-PIM review threshold of 20 mg daily), is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Sertraline, an antidepressant that is not on the list, is supplied monthly. None of fluoxetine, paroxetine or fluvoxamine appears.
